published.source: DPS report 2026-10-28 (full re-sim at 20,000 iterations, 180 s, after the launch-realm hunter hotfix)

summary: Shadow with Holy points of healing utility instead of Discipline.
rotation: Pre-pull: Shadowform at -4.5s, Shadowguard (Troll) at -3s, Mind Blast at -1.5s that lands at the pull; the on-use trinket and Major Spellblasting Potion at -0.1s
Dark Sacrifice (Undead) below 10% mana; racials and trinkets on cooldown
Shadow Word: Pain whenever it is down (9+ s left in the fight)
Devouring Plague whenever it is down and off its 24s cooldown (12+ s left)
Shadow Word: Death on cooldown, then Inner Focus right before Mind Blast and Mind Blast on cooldown
Shadowguard (Troll) again once its charges are spent, with 60+ s left and 40%+ mana
Mind Flay to fill; clipped after the second tick if SW:P or Devouring Plague fell off, never clipped for Mind Blast
Wand Shoot from 10% to 20% mana with 60+ s left, and when nothing else can be cast
caveats: The Holy points add no DPS except Twilight Focus (pushback protection).
Runs out of mana on long fights. The Undead's Dark Sacrifice helps there (876.9 vs 858.8 with the wand at 300s, measured before the race re-pick).
Only the 2-piece set bonus is active. Raiments 4-piece and 5-piece are not measured with Devouring Plague's 24s cooldown.
Periodic spells crit per tick (Forever rule). Assumed: Shadow Weaving applies to the priest's own Shadow damage.
Mind Flay rolls hit once and isn't hasted. SW:Death backlash is ignored.
Left out: Brilliant Wizard Oil (+12.5) and Elixir of Sages (+13.9).
notes: mksettings request plus manaRegenElixir GreaterMagebloodElixir (ConsumesHoly in presets.ts). Only the Undead number is published for this build; no per-faction race table.
